defect_observations: Readonly host handbook/parts/p03/qe-categoricity-games-supplement.tex:127-154 (thm:p03-vaught-two-cardinal) carries cited=Vaught1965CardinalsFarApart, attributing the (aleph1,aleph0) theorem to the far-apart paper, plus a method sketch via indiscernibles and Ehrenfeucht-Mostowski stretching to length aleph1. The owned body (lines 23-24, 527-528, 549-551) says that this key names the far-apart paper and that the indiscernible method belongs to the far-apart theorem. The route therefore carries contradictory attribution and method text. The sketch is also doubtful as a proof route for the (aleph1,aleph0) theorem.
